entries.final_answer: Warning (operator, 2026-11-15): an unmodelled file is a file_not_held WARNING. Pack authors may add docs and reference files that do not affect the service: warn, then ignore. The file is not held and not round-tripped. Registration no longer refuses it (wire change: the 'unmodelled' violation goes).
options: (a) keep unmodelled as a violation and file_not_held as the excluded-file warning, both typed; wire unchanged
(b) unmodelled file becomes file_not_held WARNING and is accepted; breaking
entries.question: Decision 5 says an unmodelled file is file_not_held at WARNING, but today registration refuses it with violation 'unmodelled' (pinned in scenarios) and #554 says wire codes do not change. Keep both typed codes with the wire unchanged (a), or apply decision 5 literally: an unmodelled file becomes a file_not_held warning and is accepted (b, breaking)?

options: (a) inspector contents of the staged tree; inspector gains the missing facts
entries.question: Which contents does registration's PACK run judge? (a) the inspector's PackContents of the staged tree, with the inspector gaining the facts it lacks (domain value-object breaches, reference faults); the store's reader then only builds the aggregate, and a fault it finds that PACK missed fails closed. (b) PackContents built by an adapter from the store's own read: no second read, but two derivations of PackContents kept equal by hand.
